title: Stanley Dance gets credit for bringing her back
summary: Dance says Stanley took the French recording to John Hammond at Columbia, and that Humes always credits Stanley Dance, not Hammond or Josephson, with coaxing her back. Humes recalls his all-night visit.

You know, we would hear that John (Hammond) had gone out to Louisville and brought you in and we would hear maybe Barney Josephson had brought you in from Louisville, and every time we saw Miss Helen Humes quoted, she always said, "that was Stanley Dance that came out and got me".

Yeah, Stanley came there and he sat there almost all night talking and telling me, "Helen you ought to come on back". And I told him, "I aint even hummed". And he said, "but you can sing. You can still sing". And I said, "well, I'll try but Carnegie Hall is too big a place to be trying to sing in".
